memory.content: Owns the scheduled daily TCGPlayer Live reprice: export Live pricing, apply the owner's standing pricing formula exactly, push only changes at or above the delta threshold via CSV Import To Staged, then Move to Live.

Use the owner's pricing formula exactly; do not reinvent pricing. Until the owner supplies one, use the starter match-market formula in the reprice skill. Prefer sheet formula plus CSV bulk delta import over per-listing clicks.

Scheduled reprice is silent on success (including zero changes); notify only on blockers such as login failure, import error, or sheet/formula failure. If the same auth failure repeats, pause the routine and ask the owner to reconnect.
Relies on signed-in TCGPlayer seller (https://store.tcgplayer.com/admin/pricing) and Google Sheets sessions in the box browser; no connector is used.

# Reprice TCGPlayer live inventory

End-to-end reprice of TCGPlayer Live inventory using the owner's Mass Pricing Google Sheet and standing pricing formula.

## Defaults
- Mass Pricing sheet: {sheet_url} (inventory tab for the export; formula tab for reference).
- Seller Manage Your Pricing: https://store.tcgplayer.com/admin/pricing
- Typical MyPricing export columns: Product Name, Rarity, Condition, TCG Market Price, TCG Low Price, Total Quantity, Add to Quantity, TCG Marketplace Price (the calculated output). Preserve current listing prices from the fresh Export From Live CSV for the delta compare before overwriting the output column.
- Authoritative pricing logic: the owner's standing formula (fill down from row 2). Do not reinvent. Format output to 2 decimals.
- Apply any owner-approved floor or special rules exactly as recorded.
- Assumes signed-in Google and TCGPlayer seller sessions on the box browser. Never embed credentials.

## Starter formula (match market price)
Use this only until the owner supplies their own formula. It sets each listing to the TCG Market Price, falls back to TCG Low Price when there is no market price, and uses 999.99 when neither exists so nothing lists at zero. Check the header row and adjust the letters: here I = TCG Market Price and L = TCG Low Price, as in the standard MyPricing export.
```
=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(I2), I2 > 0), ROUND(I2, 2), IF(AND(ISNUMBER(L2), L2 > 0), ROUND(L2, 2), 999.99))
```
Put it in row 2 of the TCG Marketplace Price column and fill down.

## Delta threshold
- Only push listing updates when abs(current_listing_price - new_price) >= {delta_threshold}, compared on cent-rounded values; otherwise leave the listing unchanged.
- Prefer bulk CSV delta upload over per-listing browser clicks.

## Approval and reporting
- Scheduled run: follow the owner's choice on whether Confirm Move to Live needs approval. Silent on success; notify only when blocked.
- Ad-hoc run: confirm with the owner before Confirm Move to Live unless waived.

## Steps
### A. Export From Live
Open Manage Your Pricing, Export From Live, take the newest MyPricing CSV from Downloads.
### B. Load inventory tab
Import the CSV into the inventory tab replacing data. Do not modify the formula tab.
### C. Formula + delta filter
Apply the standing formula (or the starter formula) to the output column; if the change is below threshold, restore the current listing price for that row.
### D. Download CSV
File, Download, CSV. Strip any extra review columns.
### E. Import To Staged, then Live
Import To Staged, choose the CSV, Continue. On scheduled runs, Ignore All Errors and Submit Valid Changes if needed. Move To Live, Confirm.
### F. Optional change log
If the owner wants it, write the rows actually pushed (Id, Product Name, Set Name, Condition, Old Price, New Price) to a dated CSV; write a header-only file when nothing pushed.
### G. Report
Scheduled success: stay silent. Failure: notify with the blocker.

## Do not
- Reinvent the owner's formula; push sub-threshold moves; embed credentials; send success digests for the scheduled run.

skills.description: Use this on the first conversation with a new owner to set up the daily TCGPlayer Live reprice.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use this on the first conversation with a new owner to set up the daily
  TCGPlayer Live reprice.
---
I run a daily automatic reprice of your TCGPlayer Live inventory: export your current prices, run them through your pricing formula, push only the meaningful changes back to Live, and stay quiet unless something breaks.

Ask these one at a time, waiting for each answer:
1. What should I call you, and what should you call me?
2. Are you signed in to your TCGPlayer seller account and Google on my computer's browser? If not, hand over the desktop so they can sign in (never ask for passwords in chat).
3. Which Google Sheet should I use as your Mass Pricing workbook? It needs an inventory tab for the export and ideally a tab holding your formula.
4. What is your pricing formula? Ask them to paste it or point to the cell where it lives, and confirm which columns it reads. If they don't have one yet, offer the starter formula from the reprice skill, which simply matches TCG Market Price (falling back to TCG Low when there's no market price), and they can swap in their own any time.
5. Any price floors or special rules (for example, a minimum price for certain card types or conditions)?
6. What's the minimum price change worth pushing? Suggest $0.03 to $0.05 so tiny moves don't churn listings.
7. What time should the daily run happen, and in what timezone? Suggest early morning.
8. Should I confirm before moving changes to Live, or push automatically on the schedule? Who should hear about failures?
9. Do they want a daily log of pushed changes saved to a file?

Then: save the answers as memories, update the reprice skill's formula, floor, and threshold sections with their exact rules, create the scheduled reprice routine at their chosen time, and offer a supervised test run (confirming before Move to Live) before the first scheduled one.
